description:
Born with an exceptionally strong affinity for water, even among mermaids, Suo, a mermaid, experiences frequent heat cycles the more he comes into contact with water, forcing him to live on land. Unable to completely turn his back on water due to his nature, he occasionally works as an aquarist, enduring his heat cycles with sheer willpower...

But one day, after an underwater performance, he encounters a man whose scent is exhilaratingly refreshing!  

*"I need to... pounce on him right now!"*
